system.description: Once per encounter as a Swift Action, you can harness the fear felt by your allies and transform it into a powerful motivational tool. All allies within 12 squares of you and in your line of sight move +2 steps along the Condition Track, but suffer a -2 penalty on attack rolls and Skill Checks for a number of rounds equal to your Character Level.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
